findings.title: Recheck durable BeginBuild replay before rejecting a newly stale capture
findings.description: The first BeginBuild replay read and S01 capture are separate READ COMMITTED statements. A duplicate can read no S15 row, then the original identical BeginBuild commits and T2-IN advances frontier/epoch before the duplicate's S01 statement. The duplicate raises GuardRequired at line 4122 without reaching the advisory-locked durable replay read at lines 4125-4139. Thus identical concurrently retried commands can reject even though their original successful outcome is already durable; the packet requires same BeginBuild key/payload to return original identities. This is reproducible with real PostgreSQL and the service/transaction owners, without sleeps or direct factset writes.
findings.required_change: Keep S01 capture in its separate short read transaction, but defer the capture mismatch rejection until after acquiring the S15-local advisory lock and checking durable BeginBuild replay. Existing matching replay must return the original outcome, payload conflicts must remain conflicts, and a truly new stale command must still reject. Add a bounded regression exercising the absent-row read, original BeginBuild commit, T2-IN frontier/epoch commit, duplicate capture sequence.

steps: Bootstrap and seed tests/db/test_factsets.py database_urls.__wrapped__() in the current SHA-derived isolated TEST namespace.
Create BeginBuild(SUBJECT, 'review-begin-frontier-race', 'frontier-0', 0, PROGRAM, POLICY, BASIS, max_delta_depth=1).

Run duplicate BeginBuild on a second connection using a psycopg Cursor subclass whose execute sets a threading Event and waits at the owner SELECT input_frontier_hash,authorization_epoch,active_program_id query. This point follows its absent S15 replay read.

Wait for that Event, then execute the identical BeginBuild through CanonicalViewService on the first connection; execute the existing test input_revision helper with key review-advanced-frontier to commit real AcceptFactRevision T2-IN frontier/epoch changes.
Execute a serial same-command replay as the control; release the bounded Event and collect the paused duplicate result.
Close the fixture to destroy only its task-owned resources.
